title: keel decision (ADR)
description: The frontmatter of a project decision, .keel/decisions/ADR-<5>-<slug>.md (in flight: the proposal's decisions/ folder, promoted into .keel/decisions/ by the land archive commit). The body must contain the level-2 sections in x-keel-sections, in order; $defs/body is what the deterministic parser produces, with no LLM extraction. Obligations are delivered when applies_to intersects a write_set, and must and must_not ids join the ACK id set.
$comment: x-keel-sections is an annotation keyword registered by scripts/validate.mjs, which checks mapped Markdown examples against it. keel's own design ADRs under docs/adr/ are a separate sequence and use no schema.

status.description: Accepted only through a contract approval or keel approve --doc; drift in a cited anchor or in the body voids acceptance.

proposal.description: Proposal that introduced the decision, or null for a decision accepted directly with --doc.

governs.description: Elements and requirements this decision governs.

date.description: Date of the last status change.

body.description: The decision body as the parser reads it.

obligation.description: One row of the Obligations table, whose columns are Id | Level | Text | Applies to | Check. Applies to holds one or more backticked globs separated by commas; Check holds one backticked command, whose argv is the code span split on single spaces with no quoting (wrap complex commands in a project script), or the word none.

check.description: Optional check command, run in the verify gate without a shell.

cheap.description: When true the check also runs in the submit gate.

rejectedOption.description: One rejected option, written as '- <option>: <reason>'. Each compiles to a must_not obligation for the same scope.

citation.description: An anchor, written as '- `<path>:<line>` (<provenance>): <note>'. Drift in a cited anchor voids acceptance.
